title: Wanting action after the Bondi attack is understandable - but kneejerk responses that curtail freedoms have their own perils
summary: Proposed changes to gun laws and protest rights in NSW need to be approached with forensic clarity – taking a pause might be wiser Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast It is understandable that the Minns Labor government wants to rush new restrictions about guns and protests into law. A tragedy like the Bondi massacre demands action – and the unpredictable political wave of public feeling after a disaster can either wipe you out or see you riding high.
